map.简支梁与连续梁的弯矩公式为何不同？: Why Do the Bending Moment Formulas Differ Between Simply Supported and Continuous Beams?
map.连续梁因中间支座产生负弯矩，内支点弯矩最大（(g+q)L²/12）、跨中较小（(: A continuous beam gets negative moments at the intermediate supports, so the interior support moment is largest ((g+q)L²/12) and midspan is smaller ((g+q)L²/24); a simply supported beam peaks only at midspan ((g+q)L²/8). The bridge type directly affects the reinforcement quantity and cost.
